territorial_scope.description: Applies to AI providers and deployers domiciled in Chile, to importers, distributors and authorised representatives domiciled in Chile, and to foreign providers and deployers whose system output is used in Chile.

summary.short: Bill regulating AI systems by risk: bans unacceptable uses, imposes duties on high-risk systems, requires transparency for limited-risk systems and synthetic content. Applies to providers and deployers in Chile and to foreign providers whose output is used there. Fines in UTM; applies from the twelfth month after publication.
summary.long: Bill (merged with boletín 15.869-19) approved by the Chamber of Deputies and sent to the Senate on 13 October 2025. Applies to providers, deployers, importers, distributors and authorised representatives in Chile, and to foreign providers and deployers whose output is used in Chile. Classifies uses by risk (Art. 6): unacceptable uses are banned (Art. 7, e.g. subliminal manipulation, social scoring, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces); high-risk uses must meet risk management, data governance, documentation, logging, human oversight, accuracy and cybersecurity rules and post-market monitoring (Arts. 8–10); limited-risk uses must be transparent (Art. 11), and generated synthetic content must be identifiable (Art. 5). Exempt: national defence systems, pre-market research and testing, and free open-source components. Controlled testing spaces create liability for harm (Art. 12); SMEs get priority access (Art. 13); ministries promote ethical development (Art. 14). Infringements are minor, serious or very serious (Art. 16), with fines up to 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 UTM (Art. 17) and civil claims (Arts. 18–19). Applies from the first business day of the twelfth month after publication in the Diario Oficial.

notes: The document is the Cámara de Diputados transmittal (13 Oct 2025) to the Senate of the approved refundido text of Boletines 15.869-19 and 16.821-19; the registry status 'pending' comes from metadata. This text states no enabling act and no amended or repealed law, so no legal_basis, amends or repeals relations are coded. Sanction provisions (arts. 16-17) name only the APDP; the ANCI appears for principles and inspection procedures (arts. 4, 9) but not in the sanction provisions. Art. 2(b) refers to arts. 12 and 18, and art. 2(c) to art. 19, within this bill; these internal references are not coded as relations. Art. 12 exempts sandbox participants from administrative fines under art. 17 but not from liability for damages. The art. 16(3) 'leve' catch-all covers any obligation without a specific sanction. The small-enterprise size test in art. 9, numeral 6 is defined only by reference to Law 20.416. The transitional article sets entry into force from the first business day of the twelfth month after publication in the Diario Oficial (not coded here).

Sistema de IA: sistema basado en máquinas, algoritmos o modelos matemáticos que, en función de objetivos explícitos o implícitos infiere, a partir de los datos de entrada que recibe, cómo generar resultados o salidas
Riesgo: la combinación de la probabilidad de que se produzca un daño a las personas, a su salud, a su seguridad o a sus derechos fundamentales y la gravedad de dicho daño.
Riesgo significativo: riesgo resultante de la combinación de su gravedad, intensidad, probabilidad de ocurrencia y duración de sus efectos
Proveedor: la persona natural o jurídica u organismo del Estado que desarrolla un sistema de IA con miras a introducirlo en el mercado o ponerlo en servicio
Implementador: la persona natural o jurídica u organismo del Estado que utiliza un sistema de IA, salvo que se trate de su uso privado
Representante autorizado: la persona natural o jurídica domiciliada en Chile que recibe y acepta el mandato por escrito de un proveedor de un sistema de IA
Importador: la persona natural o jurídica domiciliada en Chile que introduce en el mercado o pone en servicio un sistema de IA
Distribuidor: la persona natural o jurídica que forma parte de la cadena de suministro, distinta del proveedor o del importador
Operador: el proveedor, el implementador, el representante autorizado, el importador y/o el distribuidor.
Puesta en servicio: el suministro de un sistema de IA para su primer uso directamente por parte del implementador
Identificación biométrica: el reconocimiento automatizado de características humanas de tipo físico, fisiológico o conductual para determinar la identidad de una persona
Sistema de identificación biométrica remota: aquel sistema de IA destinado a identificar a personas naturales a distancia

definitions.term: Sistema de identificación biométrica remota en tiempo real

evidence.quote: Sistema de identificación biométrica remota en tiempo real: aquel en el que la recogida de los datos biométricos, su comparación y la identificación de una persona se producen sin una demora significativa.
Incidente: el uso de un sistema de IA que produzca alguna de las siguientes consecuencias:
Espacio controlado de pruebas: aquel entorno controlado que facilita el desarrollo, la prueba y la validación de sistemas de IA.
Espacio de acceso público: aquel lugar físico de propiedad pública o privada que es accesible para el público
Categorización biométrica: clasificación de personas según categorías concretas, o inferencia de sus características y atributos

definitions.term: Componente de seguridad de un producto o sistema de IA

evidence.quote: Componente de seguridad de un producto o sistema de IA: aquel que cumple una función de seguridad para dicho producto o sistema
Uso indebido razonablemente previsible: la utilización de un sistema de IA de un modo que no corresponde a su finalidad prevista
Finalidad prevista: el uso para el que un operador concibe un sistema de IA, incluido el contexto y las condiciones de uso concretas

se entenderá por “uso” el desarrollo, prueba y validación de los sistemas de IA, así como su distribución, introducción en el mercado, puesta en servicio, o cualquier actividad realizada por un operador.

obligations.summary: Persons who are not addressed by a specific article but fall within the operator category must observe eleven general principles: human oversight, technical robustness and security, privacy and data governance, transparency and identification, social diversity and fairness, social and environmental well-being, accountability, consumer protection, gender equity, copyright, and explainability.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: Todos los operadores a los que se aplica la presente ley deberán observar los siguientes principios generales

obligations.summary: AI systems must identify themselves as artificial agents each time they interact with humans, so that people know they are communicating with an AI system.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: deberán identificarse como agentes artificiales en cada oportunidad en que interactúen con seres humanos

obligations.summary: Those responsible for placing on the market, putting into service or using AI systems must review the long-term effects of their application on society, democracy and the environment.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: los responsables de la introducción en el mercado, la puesta en servicio o la utilización de los sistemas de IA deberán revisar los efectos a largo plazo

obligations.summary: Operators of AI systems must publish annual reports on environmental impact through their available dissemination channels, including social networks and websites.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: los operadores de sistemas de IA deberán publicar informes anuales sobre al impacto medioambiental en los canales de difusión de que dispongan

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Science, the APDP and the ANCI must incorporate the Article 4 principles into guidance for operators and into their regulation and supervision within their competences. The Secretaría de Gobierno Digital may also issue guidelines on the matter.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: incorporarán estos principios en las distintas orientaciones destinadas a prestar asistencia al operador en cuanto al modo de desarrollar y utilizar sistemas de IA

obligations.summary: Operators of AI systems that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text must ensure that outputs are identifiable as artificially generated or manipulated.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: operator generates synthetic audio, image, video or text content

evidence.quote: velará porque sus resultados o salidas sean identificables como generados o manipulados de manera artificial

obligations.summary: Distribution, placing on the market or putting into service of AI systems intended for unacceptable-risk uses is prohibited.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is intended for an unacceptable-risk use as defined in Art. 7

evidence.quote: Se prohíbe la distribución, introducción en el mercado o puesta en servicio de sistemas de IA destinados a tales usos.

obligations.summary: Uses of AI systems that alter behaviour through manipulation or deception, or that exploit characteristics of persons to cause harmful behaviour, are prohibited. Art. 7 also lists further unacceptable categories (sensitive-data categorisation, social scoring, non-selective facial image extraction, emotion inference in listed settings, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces); the text carries exceptions for therapeutic purposes.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: En particular, se prohíben los usos de sistemas de IA que, mediante manipulación o engaño

obligations.summary: The high-risk use of AI systems must seek to respect the fundamental rights of persons and must prevent the creation of stereotypes and the degradation of persons or groups who interact with the system.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is used in a high-risk use as defined in Art. 8

evidence.quote: El uso de alto riesgo de sistemas de IA deberá procurar el respeto de los derechos fundamentales de las personas.

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must be subject to an iterative, continuous risk assessment process throughout the system lifecycle, with periodic reviews and updates, and risk management may be integrated into existing procedures; measures against incidents are to be included.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is classified as high-risk use under Art. 8

evidence.quote: Se someterán a un proceso iterativo continuo de evaluación de riesgos que se llevará a cabo durante todo el ciclo de vida del sistema

obligations.summary: Where high-risk AI systems use model-training techniques with data, they must have data governance appropriate to their purpose and context of use, incorporate data security and protection standards, and include mechanisms for preventing and managing information security incidents.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is high-risk and uses model training with data

evidence.quote: Si utilizan técnicas de entrenamiento de modelos con datos deberán contar con una gobernanza de datos adecuada a su propósito y contexto de uso.

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must have functions that log information and security events during operation, stored with safeguards against alteration, loss or unauthorised access and with access restricted to authorised personnel and the competent supervisory authority. Technical documentation must be intelligible and demonstrate compliance with the law.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

evidence.quote: Deberán contar con funciones que permitan registrar información y eventos de seguridad mientras están en funcionamiento.

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must have technical and operational mechanisms allowing supervision by technically trained natural persons, ensuring use in line with the intended purpose and identifying and mitigating risks of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

evidence.quote: Deberán contar con mecanismos técnicos y operativos que permitan su supervisión por personas naturales técnicamente capacitadas para esta función

obligations.summary: High-risk AI systems must respect security by design and by default, reach an adequate level of accuracy, resilience, security and cybersecurity, and implement security measures aligned with Arts. 3, 7 and 9 of Law 21.663 (cybersecurity framework law).
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

evidence.quote: El funcionamiento de estos sistemas deberá respetar el principio de seguridad desde el diseño y por defecto

obligations.summary: Where a high-risk use does not comply with the rules, the operator must immediately take the necessary measures to deactivate, withdraw from the market or suspend the system, as set out in its risk management system.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: high-risk use of an AI system does not comply with Art. 9 rules

evidence.quote: el operador adoptará inmediatamente las medidas necesarias para desactivarlo, retirarlo del mercado o suspenderlo.

obligations.summary: Operators must establish and document a monitoring system proportionate to the nature and identified risks of their high-risk uses, collecting and analysing data to assess performance over the system's lifetime and, where relevant, interaction with other interconnected AI environments.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

evidence.quote: Los operadores establecerán y documentarán un sistema de seguimiento, que sea proporcional y adecuado a la naturaleza y riesgos identificados en sus usos.

obligations.summary: Limited-risk AI systems must ensure transparency and safety conditions proportionate to their risk level, so that people are clearly informed and can recognise that they are interacting with an AI system.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
obligations.conditional_on: AI system is limited-risk under Art. 11

evidence.quote: Los sistemas de IA de riesgo limitado deberán garantizar condiciones de transparencia y seguridad proporcionales a su nivel de riesgo

obligations.summary: The State, through the Ministries of Science and of Economy, Development and Tourism, must promote measures giving SMEs priority access to existing AI sandboxes (subject to budget availability), and awareness, capacity-building and advanced digital skills initiatives for SMEs, extended to civil society organisations on objective, public and non-discriminatory criteria.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: propiciará medidas tendientes a:

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation, in coordination with the Ministry of Economy, Development and Tourism, must promote the ethical and responsible development of AI and establish innovation support measures. obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

evidence.quote: promoverá el desarrollo ético y responsable de la inteligencia artificial en el país

obligations.summary: Persons, companies and state bodies involved in applying the law must respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained from an AI system, protecting in particular intellectual property, trade secrets including source code, personal data, public interest and national security, and the integrity of criminal cases or administrative proceedings.
obligations.applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)

obligations.summary: Stated in the definition of authorised representative: a Chile-domiciled person accepts a written mandate from an AI provider to comply with the obligations of this law on the provider's behalf.

enforcement.max_penalty_text: No amount stated. Remedies: cessation of harmful acts, indemnification of damages, measures to prevent a continuing infringement where imminent irreparable harm exists, and publication of the judgment at the convicted party's expense where the judgment so orders
enforcement.penalty_reference: Art. 18 nos. 1 to 4; Art. 19 (procedimiento sumario, Título XI del Libro Tercero del Código de Procedimiento Civil)
